description: Impulse Tracker 2.14 by Jeffrey Lim, the DOS music tracker, running in your browser with its example songs.
about: Impulse Tracker is a music tracker for MS-DOS by Jeffrey Lim, written mostly in 1995 and 1996. This is version 2.14 with Patch 3, from December 1997, with two example songs.
What you save in it stays in this browser: the Files button can download it, bring in modules of your own, or start over.
terms: Freeware for non-commercial use: “YOU MAY NOT CHARGE ANYTHING FOR THIS PROGRAM” (IT.TXT). Its source was later released under the BSD 3-Clause license.
accuracy: It runs its non-MMX sound driver, so its resonant filters are off: FILTERS.TXT says only the MMX drivers have them.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: Impulse Tracker's Load Module screen, running in DosKit
